note: Retrieval-only query expansion hints for documentation RAG discovery. Each entry maps product concepts as they appear in Jira/ticket wording to the terminology product documentation actually uses. These are retrieval hints only: they never become evidence, never appear in source lines, and never become acceptance claims. Grow this list through the same provenance discipline as guides_vocabulary.json (a real retrieval miss plus the documentation page that used the different term). Keep it small; broad synonym dictionaries are not the mechanism.

expansions.rationale: Product documentation describes per-run output status under Generated Outputs / Outputs tab on the Map dashboard and Map console, not under the phrase output history.
Documentation describes warning visibility through the output/publish log and status columns, not through the customer phrase traffic light.
The log viewer for a generated output is documented under output-generation troubleshooting actions (View log/Download log).
Documentation describes editing and rendering XML attributes through named Web Editor surfaces rather than an arbitrary attribute identifier from a ticket.
